name: (table)
description: metadata about extracellular electrodes

name: location
description: the location of channel within the subject e.g. brain region

name: group
description: a reference to the ElectrodeGroup this electrode is a part of

name: group_name
description: the name of the ElectrodeGroup this electrode is a part of

name: is_data_valid
description: True for electrodes/channels with usable data

name: probe_vertical_position
description: length-wise position of electrode/channel on device (microns)

name: probe_horizontal_position
description: width-wise position of electrode/channel on device (microns)

name: x
description: the x coordinate of the position (+x is posterior)

name: y
description: the y coordinate of the position (+y is inferior)

name: z
description: the z coordinate of the position (+z is right)

name: reference
description: Description of the reference electrode and/or reference scheme used for this                         electrode, e.g.,"stainless steel skull screw" or "online common average referencing".

name: (table)
description: experimental epochs

name: start_time
description: Start time of epoch, in seconds

name: stop_time
description: Stop time of epoch, in seconds

name: tags
description: user-defined tags

name: (table)
description: experimental trials

name: start_time
description: Start time of epoch, in seconds

name: stop_time
description: Stop time of epoch, in seconds

name: stimulus_type
description: type of stimulus delivered

name: stimulus_description
description: more specific description of stimulus type

name: estim_current
description: electrical stimulation current (μA), if applicable

name: estim_target_region
description: electrical stimulation target region, if applicable

name: estim_target_depth
description: electrical stimulation target depth (cortical layer), if applicable

name: behavioral_epoch
description: behavioral epoch when stimulus was delivered

name: is_running
description: True if mouse is running during trial, running defined as average speed > 0 cm/s between [-0.5, 0.5] s from stimulus onset

name: is_valid
description: True for valid trials, trials are invalid if they have large electrical artifacts or if electrical stimulation was off target

name: ElectricalSeriesEEG
description: voltage measured over time and associated timestamps from EEG array

name: (module)
description: processed behavioral data

name: running_speed
description: running speed data, computed from wheel angular velocity
